title: A connector allow-list fails open when platform-settings integrations is not a clean array; one admin Settings save lifts every restriction
description:
## BLUF

**A connector restricted by a document-type allow-list becomes UNRESTRICTED whenever the stored platform-settings** `integrations` **container is not a clean array of object entries. One ordinary save on the admin portal's Settings page produces exactly such a container.**

* Major, pre-existing: the same at develop before PR #1035, at #1035's head and on the merged tree.
* It widens authorisation through the product's own UI, and it is silent: `GET /api/connector/info` then tells the connector `[]`.
* Found by the #1035 tier-1 QA gate (finding N-1, D1). Filed as its own ticket, not folded into KS-1230, per Wednesday's ruling.

## Recommendation

The owner's fix. Not built here. An escalation candidate (the gate's grading).

* **Read side, fail closed, in both readers:** `services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts:1212-1219` (the create path) and `services/api-gateway/src/services/health.ts:45-52` (the info reader). For the calling connector, any of these should refuse instead of reading as no restriction:
  * a non-array `integrations`;
  * a non-object entry;
  * a duplicate id;
  * a non-object `config`.
* **Portal:** `frontend/admin/src/pages/Settings.tsx` must not regroup `integrations`, or any array, through `key.split('.')`. It flattens every category into `category.key` form values on load (`:37-42`) and splits them back on save (`:66`), which turns an array into `{"0": entry}`.
* **Regression cells:** each container shape below × {typed, untyped} → 403. A Settings-save round trip keeps `integrations` an array.

## Detail

* **Repro** (measured at runtime by the gate: the real route, both boots):
  1. As SYSTEM_ADMIN, `PUT /api/admin/settings` with `integrations: [{ id: "c1", config: { allowedDocumentTypes: ["SSD_DOCUMENT"] } }]` and a `general.platformName`.
  2. Connector `c1` sends `POST /api/documents` with `documentType: "DOCUMENT"` → 403.
  3. On the admin portal Settings page, change the platform name and save. The PUT body carries `integrations` as `{"0": {...}}`. The portal transform was PROBED by emulation and confirmed by reading `Settings.tsx`; no browser was driven.
  4. The same create → **201, forwarded to originate**.
* **Stored containers measured fail-open.** Each gives typed `DOCUMENT` → 201 forwarded, and info tells `[]`:
  * `{"0": entry}`;
  * `[null, entry]` (`.find` throws on `null.id`);
  * `[{id, config: {}}, entry]` (duplicate id, first wins);
  * `[{id, config: "SSD_DOCUMENT"}]`;
  * `"x"` (`.find` is not a function);
  * `null`.
  * Control: `[entry]` → 403.
* **Mechanism:** the container parse sits inside `try { … } catch {}`. A throw or a miss leaves `connectorConfig = {}`, which reads as no restriction. The same parse is in the info reader.
* **Related:**
  * KS-1204: PR #1035 made the leaf value fail closed, but the container above it still fails open;
  * KS-1230: write-side validation of the value, a different defect;
  * the 24 h platform-settings TTL expiry, the same fail-open class, filed separately.
* **Searched before filing:** Linear literal matches in titles, descriptions and comments, archived included, at most 6 pages of 50 fuzzy results per term (2026-09-17 \~16:00Z):
  * `Settings.tsx`: 0 of 118 scanned.
  * `connectorConfig`: 0, but the fuzzy search returned only 1 result, so that zero is the search's reach, not the board.
  * `integrations`: 15, none about the container parse (the security-review umbrellas KS-485, KS-488 and KS-492, harness tickets and m365 redirect tickets).
  * `platform-settings`: 3. KS-1230 (write-side validation of the allow-list value), KS-1176 (comments) and KS-37 (admin SPA tests); none covers the container.
* **Evidence:** #1035 gate report, finding N-1: `Testing Agent MAIN/projects/secuura/reports/2026-09-18-ks1204-1035-4b1fb0621-tier1-r1/report.md`. Line references re-read at develop `34cdcfb26`.
* Refs KS-1204.

nodes.title: Refs KS-1231: the admin Settings page never sends the integrations array, shows its nine fields read-only and saves only from loaded settings
KS-1231: refuse a malformed integrations container on create and on connector info (403)

nodes.body:
Delivered: PR 2058 (abd044f63a9d) is merged to develop and is in the running Kintsugi build (k25, base 6c9a593df4ab). Closing as done.

Closing under the done rule (card secuura-done-rule-unit-pinned-deployed-no-live-check, both halves; Wednesday's ruling of 2026-11-08 20:39Z on the board seat's table). No live check possible: the save path was not exercised on Kintsugi.

* Tests (first half): gate 256 (round 2 of 2) ran the Settings suite at the PR head 527d67b1852e, 39 of 39 green, and drove three browser scenarios in real Chrome 156 against its own build of that head (S5 a failed load, S12 a stale page, S14 the gateway's 503 text); the same drive against a build of develop failed all three. Not re-run on develop's tip (UNMEASURED by this seat).
* Reader half: PR 1171 and the reader fix are recorded as in the Kintsugi deploy b1fb543640e7 (comment f157a1bb). This PR is the portal half.
* Running build (second half): Seat D 60th's sweep of the k25 round. The bundle string `Reload settings`, counted over every file under the portal's html root, is 0 in the rollback admin image and 1 in the running admin portal (control id="root" 1 to 1; nonce 0; image 9e0370417ee3).
* What the check does NOT show (Seat D 60th's column, verbatim): No browser session. That Save never sends the integrations array, that the nine fields show read-only, and that reload works are unproved. B1 is one UI label, not the save path.
* Follow-ups, each its own ticket and none keeping this one open: KS-2113 (the suite cannot see four planted page defects; the fragment's toolchain sentence), KS-1998 (after a Redis eviction a settings save writes the defaults over stored values), KS-2111 (a stored category named `__proto__` pollutes the admin page's `Object.prototype`). Gate 256's N2 was fixed in the PR body before merge; N6 and N7 are notes.

NOT covered: the four platform suites were not run by this seat, and this seat made no API, browser or box call. Demo is frozen at 07a2d62be6a0; this closing makes no claim about it.

**BLUF:** PR 2058 round 2 of 2 is up for the gate at head 527d67b1852e (tier 1). Nothing is merged or deployed, and this ticket stays In Progress.

Round 1 (93bf64e29276) was NO GO at QA gate 236. Round 2 changes the contract: the page never sends an array category and never sends integrations in any shape, because the gateway keeps a category that is absent from the body as stored (routes/admin.ts:1200, read at develop a65ae7ed1d60). The nine integrations fields are read-only with a note (Kam's card, option a; KS 2035 keeps their home). fetchSettings now throws on a failed GET, a page without its settings turns Save off and offers Reload settings, and updateSettings throws with the gateway's own reason.

Measured, on Node v26.8.1 (not an LTS line; the LTS line was not run): 39 cells, which are 9 pass and 30 fail against round 1 and 39 of 39 at the head; 30 planted changes killed exactly as declared and 3 declared survivors; admin tsc and vite build rc 0; eslint 0 errors and 58 warnings, unchanged. Browser: real Chromium 156 against a real vite build and a stand-in gateway, 20 scenarios: round 2 passes 20 of 20, the round-1 build passes 3 of 20, and the 3 declared survivors go red exactly as declared.

Not run: a real gateway, Redis or Postgres (the browser walk uses a stand-in copied from routes/admin.ts); the four platform suites; Node 24; any real environment.

Found, not fixed here: GET /api/admin/settings reads Redis only (routes/admin.ts:1155), so after a cache eviction the page loads the four defaults. Stored data that already holds an index-keyed object is not repaired.

The admin portal image is owed a rebuild after merge, kintsugi only (demo is frozen).

**BLUF:** PR 2058 is the portal half: the admin Settings page now saves the stored `integrations` array as an array and refuses a save it cannot make safely. READY FOR GATE (TIER 1). Not merged, not deployed; this ticket stays open.

- **Where:** PR 2058, branch `feature/ks-1231-settings-save-keeps-integrations-an-array-r86`, head `93bf64e29276`, base develop `2fd6d529573c`, 6 files.
- **What changed:** new `frontend/admin/src/lib/settingsSavePayload.ts`, wired into `Settings.tsx`. The cells run with the tsx already in the root install (no test dependency): 3 pass and 16 fail against the page's own logic, 19 of 19 at head; twenty planted tampers, 19 red as declared and one declared survivor (the page glue has no executing cell). The nine scalar fields and the connector array share one key; a save that edits one of them while `integrations` is an array is refused, nothing stored. The conflict is KS 2035.
- **Env:** none touched. The admin portal image is owed a rebuild after merge; an admin editing one of the nine scalar fields will then see the refusal message.

`Refs`, not a closing reference.

Delivered: the reader half. PR 1171 (c38f3a484) refuses a malformed integrations container on create and on connector info with 403, and KS-1532 (898a1ae11) makes the info reader answer 503 when the settings read throws; both are in the kintsugi deploy b1fb543640e7 (2026-11-01). Verified by code read at b1fb543640e7, not observed live: services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts:826 answers 403 "Connector allow-list container is malformed" for a non-array container. Left open: the portal half the ticket's recommendation names is not in the tree. frontend/admin/src/pages/Settings.tsx still builds its save body with `key.split('.')` and `updates[category][field] = formValues[key]` (the lines the ticket cites), no commit has touched that file since 2026-09-18, and no Settings-save round-trip cell exists. So a routine Settings save still stores integrations as an object; the readers now refuse it (403) instead of reading it as no restriction.

**Measured again by the #1045 batch gate (`2026-09-18-batch1042-1045-tier1-r1`, section #1045 B, `evidence/probe1045.out`). This ticket is STILL OPEN (Major), and #1045 does not close it.**
- **The Settings page produces the failure itself.** A routine save of the admin Settings page over a GOOD restricted allow-list (editing only `general.platformName`) sends `integrations` as an index-keyed object (`Settings.tsx:37-42/63-71`). It stores 200 · object.
  - The creates for that connector go from 403 / 201 / 201 to **201 / 201 / 201**.
  - `GET /api/connector/info` goes from `["SSD_DOCUMENT"]` to `[]`.
  - **One routine save flips a restricted connector to unrestricted.**
- An object container holding a malformed `"DOCUMENT"` also stores with 200 and fails open.
- develop = head on every row (pre-existing).
- #1045 (KS-1230, merged as `52df64f84`) validates only an ARRAY `integrations`. Widening that 400 to an object would 400 every Settings-page save, so the fix is the page plus the readers, which is this ticket's shape.
